title: A sudden external invasion
next_chapter_hook: The Holy Sect envoy spoke slowly amid the crowd's astonishment, uttering a name that made Chen Ji's pupils constrict—Chen Nian, his sister who had been missing for years, was actually the key to the Holy Sect's long-planned Heavenly Fate Lock Key scheme.

text.content: The air in the Council Hall seemed to freeze into ice. The informant's limp body hadn't yet been dragged away when the spiritual energy fluctuation from the depths of the sect surged forth like a tsunami. Chen Ji's brow center tingled slightly—that aura, thick and viscous, carried a suffocating pressure, like an ancient fierce beast awakening from the abyss. 'The Mountain Protection Formation! Someone has breached the formation!' The alarmed cry came from outside the hall, followed by a string of hurried footsteps. Everyone in the hall changed color; the elders who had been arguing over the informant matter instantly formed a defensive formation, spiritual energy condensing into various colored lights in their palms. Chen Ji lowered his eyes, standing in the corner, his fingers unconsciously rubbing the yellowed fragment in his sleeve. The Tianji Record trembled faintly in his mind—that was the instinctive response when danger was sensed. It had come. Three months earlier than his calculations predicted.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying an unusual weight of solemnity) 'Those who come with ill intent rarely come peacefully. Boy, that aura... it's from the Holy Sect.' Chen Ji silently asked in his heart: 'The Holy Sect? Not one of the Three Great Sects?' 'The Holy Sect has always acted in shadows. For them to boldly breach a sect's mountain gate, there can only be one possibility—they want something worth撕破脸 for.'

text.content: The sky outside the hall suddenly darkened. Not because of nightfall, but because the golden light barrier that should have protected the Tianqing Sect was trembling violently. Countless cracks spread from the southeastern corner of the light screen, as if someone was hammering at this impenetrable barrier with a giant hammer. 'Boom—!' Another heavy strike. The golden light screen let out a mournful cry, cracks spreading like spiderwebs, fragments dissolving into scattered starlight in the wind. The counter-force from the Mountain Protection Formation made the attacker grunt, but that figure remained unmoved. Chen Ji raised his head, peering through the gap in the hall doors at that black shadow hovering in mid-air. The intruder wore a玄black robe, the hem embroidered with blood-red holy patterns—the unique symbol of the Holy Sect. His face was mostly hidden by a hood, revealing only a pale jaw and eyes devoid of any emotion. 'Tianqing Sect...' His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears, carrying an arrogant superiority, 'Hand over Chen Ji, and I will let bygones be bygones. Otherwise—' He raised his hand, and a blood-red pillar of spiritual energy shot skyward from his palm, directly striking the trembling Mountain Protection Formation. 'Today, the Tianqing Sect will have no reason to exist.'

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's expression turned so gloomy it seemed to drip water. He walked slowly out of the hall, his aged voice echoing above the great hall: 'The Holy Sect's reach has grown too long. This is the Tianqing Sect, not your back garden!' The black-robed figure tilted his head slightly, as if sizing up this old sect master of Tianqing. After a moment, he let out an ambiguous laugh: 'Ling Yuan? That candidate who was rejected by the Tianji Record all those years ago?' At these words, everyone in the hall changed color. A flash of killing intent flickered in Ling Yuan's eyes, but he quickly suppressed it. 'Chen Ji is a disciple of Tianqing Sect,' Ling Yuan's voice remained steady, 'not someone you can simply take away.'

The black-robed figure seemed to have lost patience. He raised his hand, and a blood-colored light screen unfolded in the air. Within the screen appeared a blurry image—a woman bound by chains, bearing a three-tenths resemblance to Chen Ji, floating motionless in the center of a massive formation. 'Recognize her?' Chen Ji's heart clenched violently. That was Chen Nian. His sister. The sister who had been missing for eight whole years. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again: 'She's locked in a Heavenly Fate formation... Damn it, the Holy Sect actually found the Heavenly Fate Lock Key!' 'Chen Ji,' the black-robed figure's voice seemed to come from the Nine Abysses, 'your sister is in our hands. As long as you come with us obediently, she can live. Otherwise—' He didn't finish, but those emotionless eyes said everything.

text.content: The hall fell into deathly silence. All eyes fell upon Chen Ji. There was surprise, confusion, schadenfreude, and scrutiny. This ordinarily timid and useless servant disciple actually had such connections with the Holy Sect? Chen Ji kept his head bowed, his expression unreadable. His shoulders trembled slightly, as if struggling to contain something. However, only he himself knew— That wasn't suppressing rage, but the killing intent surging in his heart. Chen Nian. His sister. When the Holy Sect took her, he was only twelve years old. Countless times afterward he had performed calculations, searched repeatedly, yet never found a single clue. So she had been in the Holy Sect's hands all along. So from the very beginning, he had been a chess piece of the Holy Sect. The fragment in his sleeve emitted faint warmth, the Tianji Record warning him. Chen Ji took a deep breath, raised his head, and an expression of恰到好处的 terror and bewilderment appeared on his face. 'I... I don't know what you're talking about...' His voice trembled, 'Chen Nian? I don't recognize...'

dialogue.content: 'Enough.' Su Qingyao's voice rang from the crowd. She stepped forward, her gaze toward the black-robed figure as cold as a blade. 'Holy Sect members forcefully entered my Tianqing Sect, severely damaged my Mountain Protection Formation, and demanded to take a sect disciple the moment they opened their mouths—does the Holy Sect think the Three Great Sects are all dead?' The black-robed figure seemed somewhat interested in this Inner Sect Senior Fellow. He tilted his head, the blood-colored light screen flickering slightly. 'Su Qingyao, Inner Sect Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, Foundation Building peak, could potentially form a Golden Core with more time.' His tone was like appraising merchandise. 'Unfortunately, today's matter is not something you can meddle in.' He turned his gaze to Chen Ji once more: 'Chen Ji, don't make us act. You should know the Holy Sect's methods—you don't want to see them.' In the blood-colored light screen, Chen Nian's figure appeared again. A chain pierced through her shoulder blade, blood dripping down her pale arm. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

text.content: The atmosphere in the hall was oppressively heavy to the extreme. Ling Yuan's expression shifted continuously; a complicated light flickered in his gaze toward Chen Ji—there was scrutiny, wariness, and a sliver of deeply hidden malice. The other elders whispered among themselves, but no one stepped forward to speak. The Holy Sect was too powerful; no one wanted to offend those madmen for atrash disciple. And Chen Ji, still with his head lowered, his shoulders still trembling slightly. But in his mind, the Tianji Record fragment was flickering frantically. Mo Xiansheng's voice urgently rang out: 'Boy, stay calm! This is a trap! They want you to lose your rationality—as long as you strike first, you'll fall right into their trap!' 'I know.' Chen Ji responded in his heart, his voice as cold as万年寒冰. 'I know. But the matter with Chen Nian... I cannot pretend I didn't see it.'

text.content:
Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings, taking in every expression. Ling Yuan's restraint, the other elders' indifference, the black-robed man's certainty—

He suddenly smiled.

That smile was light and faint, like willow catkins in the wind, fleeting. But Su Qingyao acutely captured that moment of palpitating fear.

Thistrashdisciple's eyes... why were they so terrifying?

"People of the Holy Sect," Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice no longer trembling, "you say Chen Nian is in your hands, and I believe you. But is your purpose in breaching the Tianqing Sect really just to take me away?"

The black-robed man's gaze shifted slightly.

Chen Ji continued: "It seems... Ling Yuan is not surprised by your arrival."

At these words, the hall erupted. Ling Yuan's face instantly turned ashen: "Brat, what do you mean!"

"The Tianqing Sect's mountain protection formation is renowned throughout the world," Chen Ji's voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears, "and today, the Holy Sect's people directly shattered the southeastern formation node upon their attack—that position just happens to be the one Lord Ling is responsible for maintaining."

"You're lying!" Ling Yuan bellowed in rage.

Chen Ji spread his hands, looking innocent: "This junior merely finds it strange—why must Lord Ling be so agitated? Feeling guilty?"

Ling Yuan's expression had already reached an extreme level of ugliness.

He hadn't expected this usually timidtrashdisciple to dare publicly pin such a hat on him. What was more infuriating was that the gazes of the surrounding elders had already begun to change—scrutiny, suspicion, wariness...

"Chen Ji!" Ling Yuan's voice was like something squeezed through his teeth, "You're slandering me with false accusations!"

Chen Ji did not respond. He simply stood there quietly, his face wearing a faint expression of fear, but his eyes held an abyss of cold.

The black-robed man watched this scene with great interest, then suddenly laughed lightly: "Interesting. So there are so many corruptions within the Tianqing Sect as well."

He had no intention of defending Ling Yuan—in truth, he didn't care about Ling Yuan's life or death at all. In his view, this was merely an expendable sideshow.

"Time is almost up," the black-robed man once again fixed his gaze on Chen Ji, "I'll say it one more time—hand over Chen Ji, or the Tianqing Sect will be removed from existence. Choose one."

dialogue.content:
Just then, another spiritual fluctuation came from outside the hall.

"Xuanwu Sect Han Lie, requesting to see the esteemed members of the Tianqing Sect!"

A sonorous voice pierced through the tense air, followed by a blazing aura descending from the heavens, landing on the empty space before the hall. The visitor wore a crimson combat attire, with sword-like brows and star-bright eyes, surrounded by faint flame patterns—that was the unique manifestation of Xuanwu Sect's cultivation arts.

Han Lie. The number one prodigy of the Xuanwu Sect, at the Great Circle of Foundation Building, only one step away from Gold Core.

His gaze swept across everyone present, finally landing on the black-robed man, a mocking arc curving at the corner of his mouth: "The Holy Sect's reach is indeed extensive, trying to interfere in the Tianqing Sect's territory?"

The black-robed man narrowed his eyes: "Han family whelp, what trouble are you stirring up?"

"The Tianqing Sect has a pact with my Xuanwu Sect," Han Lie walked boldly to the hall entrance, "if the Holy Sect wants to run wild here, you'd better ask if I agree first!"

text.content:
The situation instantly became even more complex.

The Xuanwu Sect's intervention was clearly outside the black-robed man's plans. His expression slightly darkened, blood-colored spiritual energy flickering at his fingertips as he weighed the pros and cons.

"A mere brute," the black-robed man coldly snorted.

"Brute?" Han Lie showed no anger; instead, he burst into laughter, "Today this young master will be a brute for you!"

He raised his hand, and flames transformed into a giant python, sweeping toward the black-robed man. The black-robed man flicked his sleeve, blood-colored spiritual energy forming a barrier, forcibly blocking the flame python.

The two sides held their positions momentarily, then each stepped back.

Han Lie's expression grew several degrees more solemn: "Holy Sect's trash indeed has some skill."

The black-robed man squinted, looking at the sky behind Han Lie: "You think you're the only one who came?"

Before his words finished, dozens of black shadows skimmed across the horizon, landing around the Tianqing Sect—those were reinforcements from the Holy Sect.

text.content:
Chaos is the best cover.

Chen Ji quietly retreated, his form gradually merging into the shadows. Su Qingyao seemed to sense something, turning her head to glance, but only saw a fleeing figure in panic.

"The underground of the Tianqing Sect..." she silently wondered, "could there be secrets?"

At the same time, Chen Ji had already followed the path indicated by the Tianji Record, passing through layers of barriers, arriving at a concealed tunnel entrance.

Deep within the tunnel, a massive formation was slowly operating. At the center of the formation, a familiar figure floated in mid-air—

Chen Nian.

She had grown much thinner than in memory, her face pale as paper, but traces of her former appearance remained between her brows. Her eyes were tightly closed, her body wrapped in countless golden chains, each chain connecting to different nodes of the formation.

Chen Ji's heart felt like it was being gripped by something, aching so intensely he could barely breathe.

"Little Nian... Brother is here to save you."

He whispered in his heart, then without hesitation stepped into the formation.

And Chen Ji had already vanished from the main hall in that brief moment of chaos.

This favor, he would remember."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed.

'Do you know, Chen Ji,' she stepped closer, her burning gaze fixed on him, 'I always thought you were a cold-blooded creature. Unexpected, that you also possess this kind of... emotion only humans have.'

Chen Ji glanced at her coolly: 'Aren't you the same?'

Ye Qing's smile stiffened slightly.

'The Holy Sect used you as a chess piece for so many years, yet now you're helping their enemies,' Chen Ji's voice carried no emotion. 'So don't pretend to be so noble.'

The two stared at each other for a moment. Ye Qing suddenly smiled—this time, a genuine smile.

'You really are becoming more and more interesting.'

She took out a jade slip from her sleeve and tossed it to Chen Ji: 'This contains all the Holy Sect's information on the Heavenly Fate Lock Key plan. Originally my backup plan, but now it's yours.'

Chen Ji took the jade slip, his divine sense probing into it, his expression abruptly changing.

'You see it now,' Ye Qing's voice lowered. 'Chen Nian wasn't just taken as a hostage—she's the core of the entire plan. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key requires someone with blood relation to the Tianji Record inheritor to serve as its vessel. And you...'

She paused: 'You two siblings have been chess pieces laid out by the Holy Sect since birth.'

text.content:
"The secret chamber fell into dead silence.

The hand holding the jade slip trembled slightly, but Chen Ji's expression was unexpectedly calm.

'Chess pieces...' he murmured. 'So from the very beginning, I was only a chess piece.'

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying a hint of sigh: 'The Tianji Record choosing you was itself a trap. Do you think it was coincidence it fell into your hands?'

Chen Ji closed his eyes.

He remembered his expression when Master Chen Xuan handed him the Tianji Record on his deathbed—that wasn't an inheritance, but more like... a commission.

Or rather, a transference.

'Master Chen Xuan... did he already know?' Chen Ji asked in his heart.

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a long time before slowly speaking: 'He knew part of it. But the larger scheme... even he wasn't clear about.'

Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze falling on the space beyond the secret chamber.

The outside commotion was gradually settling. The Holy Sect's search teams were everywhere looking for him. And he stood in this hidden chamber, holding the truth about his sister's fate.

Heavenly Fate Lock Key.

So the Holy Sect never wanted Chen Nian alone. They wanted to use Chen Nian to control the Tianji Record—or rather, to control him.

And Chen Nian was precisely the key that could unlock all the secrets within him."

dialogue.content:
'Boy,' Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, 'there are some things I shouldn't tell you now, but since it has come to this...'

Chen Ji's heart tensed: 'What is it?'

'The Heavenly Fate Lock Key plan is divided into three steps.' Mo Xiansheng's voice was low and slow. 'First step, select someone with blood relation to the Tianji Record inheritor as the vessel for the Lock Key. Second step, place the Lock Key in a specific formation for cultivation, waiting for the right moment.'

He paused: 'Third step... is to use the Lock Key to reversely extract the Heavenly Fate of the Tianji Record inheritor.'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

'You mean... they captured Chen Nian to—'

'That's right.' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of heaviness. 'Chen Nian has been cultivated in the Heavenly Fate Lock Key formation for eight years, long becoming a living vessel. Once they capture you, they'll use her to extract all the heavenly secrets power from you.'

'By then, you won't just lose the Tianji Record—you'll die.'

Her eyes were tightly closed, and the golden chains around her body trembled violently as Chen Ji approached. The air was thick with the power of heavenly secrets, resonating with the fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve.

"Xiao Nian..."

Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly. He reached out, and the moment his fingertips touched those golden chains, a violent force surged through the chains into his body.

That was the backlash of the Tianji Record.

Chen Ji grunted, nearly losing his balance. But he did not retreat; instead, he gripped the chains even more tightly.

Just then, Chen Nian's eyelashes fluttered slightly.

Her lips moved, producing a weak sound: "Brother... Brother?"

Chen Ji's eyes grew hot.

Eight years.整整 eight years.

She still recognized him.

"It's me," he suppressed the bitterness in his heart, keeping his voice as steady as possible, "Brother came to save you. Don't be afraid, brother is here."

Chen Nian struggled to open her eyes. Those eyes were identical to Chen Ji's, but years of imprisonment had cast a layer of gloom over them.

"Brother... You shouldn't have come..." Her voice carried a sob, "They... They were just trying to lure you here..."

Chen Ji smiled faintly: "I know."

"So brother won't let them succeed."

Before the words even finished, the formation suddenly activated.

Countless blood-colored pillars of light rose from the ground, enveloping Chen Ji within them. This was the formation's backlash after being triggered—the people of the Holy Sect had arrived at the depths below.

"Chen Ji!"

The dark-robed figure's voice came from behind, carrying uncontrollable fury: "You think you can escape? This formation was specially prepared for you!"

Chen Ji slowly turned around, facing the approaching blood light.

There was not a trace of fear on his face; instead, a faint smile curved his lips.

"Specially prepared for me?" His voice was soft, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears, "Then let me show you who is really playing whom."

He raised his hand, and the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve suddenly emitted dazzling golden light. That radiance collided with the blood-colored pillars of light in the formation, producing a deafening roar.

Heaven and earth changed color.

And in the midst of this chaos, Chen Ji's voice rang out once more, carrying a confidence bordering on madness:

"The true power of the Tianji Record is something you frogs in a well could never imagine!"

Golden light blazed brilliantly, completely enveloping the figures of Chen Ji and Chen Nian.

The next instant, the formation collapsed, the seals crumbled.

When the light faded, the stone chamber was completely empty.

The dark-robed figure stood in the empty center of the formation, his face ashen.

The formation he had carefully arranged... actually broken so easily? What means did thattrash disciple use?

"Your Excellency, the envoy..." Ling Yuan's voice trembled slightly, "That kid... he escaped?"

"Escaped?" The dark-robed figuresneered一声, "He won't get far!"

He raised his hand, and a curtain of blood light unfolded in mid-air. Within the light curtain, Chen Ji's figure carrying Chen Nian was rapidly retreating—but the void around that silhouette was twisting, as if it might tear open at any moment.

"He's using the power of the Tianji Record to forcibly tear open space," the dark-robed figure narrowed his eyes slightly, "But this method of tearing space is extremely unstable. He can't have gone far."

A glint of greed flashed in Ling Yuan's eyes: "The Tianji Record... is it really on him?"

"Whether it is or not, it will belong to us eventually." The dark-robed figure turned, sweeping his robe, "Chase!"

Meanwhile, on a desolate mountain dozens of li away.

The void tore open, and Chen Ji tumbled to the ground while clutching Chen Nian. The violent backlash caused him to spit out a mouthful of blood, but he still held the girl in his arms tightly, refusing to let go.

"Brother..." Chen Nian's voice was extremely weak, "You're injured..."

Chen Ji managed to force out a smile: "It's nothing... Brother is fine..."

His gaze fell upon the distant horizon, where dozens of streaks of blood light were flying toward this location.

But in his eyes, an unprecedented light was shining.

Chen Nian had been rescued.

Now it was time for him to collect his debts.

The Holy Sect... Ling Yuan...

And that Eye of Heavenly Dao hiding behind the scenes...

He noted each one of them.
